verdict.rationale: Natural-language control is a fair question for a consumer GPU, since its companion software could plausibly offer it, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows the RTX 5090 or its software (NVIDIA app, Broadcast, Studio) accepting natural-language commands. The evidence only covers DLSS, CUDA tooling and AI compute horsepower, which are adjacent AI features rather than natural-language operation.
